name: Accordion
description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal a section of content.
thumbnail: Accordion component for collapsible content sections
usage: Use Accordion to organize related content into collapsible sections to reduce page clutter and improve scannability.

props.name: type
props.description: Determines whether one or multiple items can be opened at the same time

props.name: collapsible
props.description: When type is 'single', allows closing an item by clicking its trigger again

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value of the item(s) to expand by default

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the item(s) to expand

examples.title: Default Accordion
examples.code:
<Accordion type="single" collapsible>
  <AccordionItem value="item-1">
    <AccordionTrigger>Is it accessible?</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>
      Yes. It adheres to the WAI-ARIA design pattern.
    </AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>

examples.title: Multiple Expanded Items
examples.code:
<Accordion type="multiple">
  <AccordionItem value="item-1">
    <AccordionTrigger>Section 1</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>Content for section 1</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem value="item-2">
    <AccordionTrigger>Section 2</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>Content for section 2</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>

name: Alert Dialog
description: A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content and expects a response.
thumbnail: Alert Dialog component for confirmation modals and alerts
usage: Use Alert Dialog to prompt the user with critical information or confirm irreversible actions such as deletion.

props.name: open
props.description: The controlled open state of the dialog

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The default open state when uncontrolled

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Event handler called when the open state changes

examples.title: Default Alert Dialog
examples.code:
<AlertDialog>
  <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
    <Button variant="destructive">Delete Account</Button>
  </AlertDialogTrigger>
  <AlertDialogContent>
    <AlertDialogHeader>
      <AlertDialogTitle>Are you absolutely sure?</AlertDialogTitle>
      <AlertDialogDescription>
        This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete your account.
      </AlertDialogDescription>
    </AlertDialogHeader>
    <AlertDialogFooter>
      <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
      <AlertDialogAction variant="destructive">Continue</AlertDialogAction>
    </AlertDialogFooter>
  </AlertDialogContent>
</AlertDialog>
